summary: Example task backs up the SLX-OS config with slxos_config backup: yes.
questions: How do I back up an SLX-OS switch config?

answer_card.title: Back up SLX-OS config
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Backup current switch config (slxos)
  community.network.slxos_config:
    backup: yes
  register: backup_slxos_location
  when: ansible_network_os == 'community.network.slxos'
```
